name: shellbags
description: Walk BagMRU in UsrClass.dat or NTUSER.DAT and return the folders a user browsed: the reconstructed path, the key's last-write time, the shell item's own DOS timestamps, and the MRU order. Reaches folders on devices and shares that are long gone.

hive.description: An extracted UsrClass.dat (or NTUSER.DAT for the older location)

key.description: Override the BagMRU root when the hive puts it somewhere unusual

contains.description: Keep only paths containing this string, case-insensitive

max_depth.description: How deep to walk (default 24); a key below it that has subkeys is named in not_walked_below_max_depth

limit.description: Entries shown inline (default 500); the whole tree is walked, and when more entries match the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results
